decisions.statement: One line has one edit, as a line beside an agent's own page has.
A subagent's page going appends the edits that subagent had not landed.
An edit already landed is beside no page, so an edit here was never landed.
The seat reaches an edit here that the subagent answering it can no longer reach.
Lines are kept outside the commit.
No author writes a line here by hand.

definition: the edits a subagent under a seat had not landed when its page went
